title: Chapter12
description: Finnish vocabulary: nature, environment, the outdoors, hobbies and verbs

questions.question: At first
questions.explanation: 'Aluksi' means at first.
questions.exampletranslate: At first I learn the basic words.

questions.question: Made of aluminium
questions.explanation: 'Alumiininen' means made of aluminium; its genitive is 'alumiinisen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The can is made of aluminium.

questions.question: Dish / Container
questions.explanation: 'Astia' means a dish or container.
questions.exampletranslate: I recycle the plastic containers.

questions.question: To spot
questions.explanation: 'Bongata' (type 4 verb) means to spot; 'bongaan' is 'I spot'.
questions.exampletranslate: I spot a rare bird.

questions.question: To introduce / present
questions.explanation: 'Esitellä' (type 3 verb) means to introduce or present; 'esittelen' is 'I introduce'.
questions.exampletranslate: I introduce you to my friend.

questions.question: To grill
questions.explanation: 'Grillata' (type 4 verb) means to grill; 'grillaan' is 'I grill'.
questions.exampletranslate: I grill sausage at the cottage.

questions.question: To chop / beat
questions.explanation: 'Hakata' (type 4 verb) means to chop, beat or hack; 'hakkaan' is 'I chop'.
questions.exampletranslate: I chop wood for winter.

questions.question: Mouse
questions.explanation: 'Hiiri' means mouse; its genitive is 'hiiren'.
questions.exampletranslate: The cat chases the mouse.

questions.question: Tag (the game)
questions.explanation: 'Hippa' means the game of tag; its genitive is 'hipan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The children play tag.

questions.question: Slow
questions.explanation: 'Hidas' means slow; its genitive is 'hitaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The internet is slow today.

questions.question: Mosquito
questions.explanation: 'Hyttynen' means mosquito; its genitive is 'hyttysen'.
questions.exampletranslate: In summer there are many mosquitoes.

questions.question: Running / Flowing
questions.explanation: 'Juokseva' means running or flowing (e.g. running water).
questions.exampletranslate: The cottage has running water.

questions.question: To feel nervous / excited
questions.explanation: 'Jännittää' (type 1 verb) means to feel nervous or excited; 'minua jännittää' means 'I feel nervous'.
questions.exampletranslate: The exam makes me nervous.

questions.question: To leave (something)
questions.explanation: 'Jättää' (type 1 verb) means to leave (something somewhere); 'jätän' is 'I leave'.
questions.exampletranslate: I leave the trash at the collection point.

questions.question: To pour / knock over
questions.explanation: 'Kaataa' (type 1 verb) means to pour or knock over; 'kaadan' is 'I pour'.
questions.exampletranslate: I pour water into the glass.

questions.question: Fabric
questions.explanation: 'Kangas' means fabric; its genitive is 'kankaan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy fabric for curtains.

questions.question: Bear
questions.explanation: 'Karhu' means bear.
questions.exampletranslate: A bear lives in the forest.

questions.question: To grow
questions.explanation: 'Kasvaa' (type 1 verb) means to grow; 'kasvan' is 'I grow'.
questions.exampletranslate: The tree grows slowly.

questions.question: Vegetarian (person)
questions.explanation: 'Kasvissyöjä' means a vegetarian (a person who eats vegetables).
questions.exampletranslate: I am a vegetarian.

questions.question: Vegetarian food
questions.explanation: 'Kasvisruoka' means vegetarian food; its genitive is 'kasvisruoan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I order vegetarian food.

questions.question: To collect / gather
questions.explanation: 'Kerätä' (type 4 verb) means to collect or gather; 'kerään' is 'I collect'.
questions.exampletranslate: I gather berries from the forest.

questions.question: To tell
questions.explanation: 'Kertoa' (type 1 verb) means to tell; 'kerron' is 'I tell'.
questions.exampletranslate: I'll tell you a story.

questions.question: To last
questions.explanation: 'Kestää' (type 1 verb) means to last; 'se kestää' means 'it lasts'.
questions.exampletranslate: The trip lasts an hour.

questions.question: Summer cottage
questions.explanation: 'Kesämökki' means summer cottage; its genitive is 'kesämökin'.
questions.exampletranslate: We spend the summer at the summer cottage.

questions.question: To forbid / deny
questions.explanation: 'Kieltää' (type 1 verb) means to forbid or deny; 'kiellän' is 'I forbid'.
questions.exampletranslate: The law forbids littering.

questions.question: Kind / Nice
questions.explanation: 'Kiltti' means kind or nice; its genitive is 'kiltin'.
questions.exampletranslate: He is a kind person.

questions.question: Stone
questions.explanation: 'Kivi' means stone; its genitive is 'kiven'.
questions.exampletranslate: There are many stones on the beach.

questions.question: Machine
questions.explanation: 'Kone' means machine; its genitive is 'koneen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The machine works well.

questions.question: Ever
questions.explanation: 'Koskaan' means ever (in negative sentences, never).
questions.exampletranslate: I have never been to Lapland.

questions.question: Greece
questions.explanation: 'Kreikka' means Greece; its genitive is 'Kreikan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I travel to Greece in summer.

questions.question: Condition / Fitness
questions.explanation: 'Kunto' means condition or fitness; its genitive is 'kunnon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I take care of my fitness.

questions.question: To count / lower
questions.explanation: 'Laskea' (type 1 verb) means to count, lower or descend; 'lasken' is 'I count'.
questions.exampletranslate: I count the money.

questions.question: To play (children)
questions.explanation: 'Leikkiä' (type 1 verb) means to play (children's play); 'leikin' is 'I play'.
questions.exampletranslate: The children play in the yard.

questions.question: To move (be in motion)
questions.explanation: 'Liikkua' (type 1 verb) means to move or be in motion; 'liikun' is 'I move'.
questions.exampletranslate: I exercise (move) every day.

questions.question: Soda / Soft drink
questions.explanation: 'Limu' means soda or soft drink (informal); its genitive is 'limun'.
questions.exampletranslate: I drink soda at the cottage.

questions.question: Bird
questions.explanation: 'Lintu' means bird; its genitive is 'linnun'.
questions.exampletranslate: The bird sings in the tree.

questions.question: Addition / Extra
questions.explanation: 'Lisä' means addition or extra.
questions.exampletranslate: I want more (additional) information.

questions.question: Number / Chapter
questions.explanation: 'Luku' means number or chapter; its genitive is 'luvun'.
questions.exampletranslate: I read the first chapter of the book.

questions.question: Nature
questions.explanation: 'Luonto' means nature; its genitive is 'luonnon'.
questions.exampletranslate: I love Finnish nature.

questions.question: Landscape / Scenery
questions.explanation: 'Maisema' means landscape or scenery.
questions.exampletranslate: The landscape is beautiful.

questions.question: Hut / Cabin
questions.explanation: 'Maja' means hut or cabin.
questions.exampletranslate: We build a hut in the forest.

questions.question: Berry
questions.explanation: 'Marja' means berry.
questions.exampletranslate: I pick berries from the forest.

questions.question: Sea
questions.explanation: 'Meri' means sea; its genitive is 'meren'.
questions.exampletranslate: The boat travels on the sea.

questions.question: Forest
questions.explanation: 'Metsä' means forest.
questions.exampletranslate: I walk in the forest.

questions.question: To hunt
questions.explanation: 'Metsästää' (type 1 verb) means to hunt; 'metsästän' is 'I hunt'.
questions.exampletranslate: He hunts in autumn.

questions.question: Blueberry
questions.explanation: 'Mustikka' means blueberry; its genitive is 'mustikan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I pick blueberries.

questions.question: To admit
questions.explanation: 'Myöntää' (type 1 verb) means to admit or grant; 'myönnän' is 'I admit'.
questions.exampletranslate: I admit that I was wrong.

questions.question: Cottage
questions.explanation: 'Mökki' means cottage; its genitive is 'mökin'.
questions.exampletranslate: We go to the cottage at the weekend.

questions.question: Wet
questions.explanation: 'Märkä' means wet; its genitive is 'märän'.
questions.exampletranslate: The clothes are wet.

questions.question: Nail
questions.explanation: 'Naula' means nail.
questions.exampletranslate: I hammer a nail into the wall.

questions.question: Nowadays
questions.explanation: 'Nykyään' means nowadays.
questions.exampletranslate: Nowadays I recycle everything.

questions.question: Actually
questions.explanation: 'Oikeastaan' means actually.
questions.exampletranslate: Actually I like the rain.

questions.question: Right / Justice
questions.explanation: 'Oikeus' means right or justice; its genitive is 'oikeuden'.
questions.exampletranslate: Everyone has the right to clean nature.

questions.question: To fish (with a rod)
questions.explanation: 'Onkia' (type 1 verb) means to fish with a rod; 'ongin' is 'I fish'.
questions.exampletranslate: I fish on the lake.

questions.question: Squirrel
questions.explanation: 'Orava' means squirrel.
questions.exampletranslate: The squirrel climbs the tree.

questions.question: To catch
questions.explanation: 'Ottaa kiinni' means to catch; 'otan kiinni' is 'I catch'.
questions.exampletranslate: I catch the fish.

questions.question: To scare / frighten
questions.explanation: 'Pelottaa' (type 1 verb) means to scare or frighten; 'minua pelottaa' means 'I am afraid'.
questions.exampletranslate: I am afraid of the dark.

questions.question: Field (agricultural)
questions.explanation: 'Pelto' means field (agricultural); its genitive is 'pellon'.
questions.exampletranslate: Wheat grows in the field.

questions.question: Basis / Grounds
questions.explanation: 'Peruste' means basis or grounds; its genitive is 'perusteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: What is the basis for the decision?

questions.question: To wash oneself
questions.explanation: 'Peseytyä' (type 1 verb) means to wash oneself; 'peseydyn' is 'I wash myself'.
questions.exampletranslate: I wash myself in the morning.

questions.question: Hiding place
questions.explanation: 'Piilo' means hiding place.
questions.exampletranslate: The child is in a hiding place.

questions.question: To draw
questions.explanation: 'Piirtää' (type 1 verb) means to draw; 'piirrän' is 'I draw'.
questions.exampletranslate: I draw a picture of nature.

questions.question: Little boy
questions.explanation: 'Pikkupoika' means little boy; its genitive is 'pikkupojan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The little boy plays in the yard.

questions.question: To pick
questions.explanation: 'Poimia' (type 1 verb) means to pick; 'poimin' is 'I pick'.
questions.exampletranslate: I pick mushrooms from the forest.

questions.question: To get to / reach
questions.explanation: 'Päästä' (type 2 verb) means to get to or reach; 'pääsen' is 'I get to'.
questions.exampletranslate: I get to the cottage in the evening.

questions.question: Peace
questions.explanation: 'Rauha' means peace.
questions.exampletranslate: There is peace in the forest.

questions.question: Iron (the metal)
questions.explanation: 'Rauta' means iron; its genitive is 'raudan'.
questions.exampletranslate: The gate is made of iron.

questions.question: Hardware store
questions.explanation: 'Rautakauppa' means hardware store; its genitive is 'rautakaupan'.
questions.exampletranslate: I buy nails from the hardware store.

questions.question: Relaxed
questions.explanation: 'Rento' means relaxed; its genitive is 'rennon'.
questions.exampletranslate: The holiday was relaxed.

questions.question: To break
questions.explanation: 'Rikkoa' (type 1 verb) means to break; 'rikon' is 'I break'.
questions.exampletranslate: I broke the glass by accident.

questions.question: Junk / Scrap
questions.explanation: 'Romu' means junk or scrap.
questions.exampletranslate: I take the old scrap to recycling.

questions.question: To litter
questions.explanation: 'Roskata' (type 4 verb) means to litter; 'roskaan' is 'I litter'.
questions.exampletranslate: Don't litter the nature.

questions.question: Traffic jam
questions.explanation: 'Ruuhka' means traffic jam.
questions.exampletranslate: In the morning there is a bad traffic jam.

questions.question: To saw
questions.explanation: 'Sahata' (type 4 verb) means to saw; 'sahaan' is 'I saw'.
questions.exampletranslate: I saw the board in two.

questions.question: Newspaper
questions.explanation: 'Sanomalehti' means newspaper; its genitive is 'sanomalehden'.
questions.exampletranslate: I read the newspaper in the morning.

questions.question: To move / transfer (something)
questions.explanation: 'Siirtää' (type 1 verb) means to move or transfer something; 'siirrän' is 'I move'.
questions.exampletranslate: I move the table to the corner.

questions.question: Stressful
questions.explanation: 'Stressaava' means stressful.
questions.exampletranslate: The work is stressful.

questions.question: Wolf
questions.explanation: 'Susi' means wolf; its genitive is 'suden'.
questions.exampletranslate: There are wolves in the forest.

questions.question: Electrical device
questions.explanation: 'Sähkölaite' means electrical device; its genitive is 'sähkölaitteen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I recycle the old electrical devices.

questions.question: To compose (music)
questions.explanation: 'Säveltää' (type 1 verb) means to compose music; 'sävellän' is 'I compose'.
questions.exampletranslate: She composes a song.

questions.question: Event
questions.explanation: 'Tapahtuma' means event.
questions.exampletranslate: The event is on Saturday.

questions.question: Inspection / Check
questions.explanation: 'Tarkistus' means inspection or check; its genitive is 'tarkistuksen'.
questions.exampletranslate: The car's inspection is tomorrow.

questions.question: Terrace
questions.explanation: 'Terassi' means terrace.
questions.exampletranslate: I drink coffee on the terrace.

questions.question: Ladder
questions.explanation: 'Tikkaat' means ladder (a plural word); its genitive is 'tikkaiden'.
questions.exampletranslate: I climb up the ladder.

questions.question: Temporary
questions.explanation: 'Tilapäinen' means temporary; its genitive is 'tilapäisen'.
questions.exampletranslate: This is a temporary solution.

questions.question: To wash dishes
questions.explanation: 'Tiskata' (type 4 verb) means to wash dishes; 'tiskaan' is 'I wash dishes'.
questions.exampletranslate: I wash the dishes in the evening.

questions.question: Fire
questions.explanation: 'Tuli' means fire; its genitive is 'tulen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I make a fire in the fireplace.

questions.question: To come
questions.explanation: 'Tulla' (type 3 verb) means to come; 'tulen' is 'I come'.
questions.exampletranslate: I come to the cottage tomorrow.

questions.question: Commute / Work trip
questions.explanation: 'Työmatka' means a commute or work trip.
questions.exampletranslate: The commute takes half an hour.

questions.question: Full
questions.explanation: 'Täynnä' means full.
questions.exampletranslate: The container is full of water.

questions.question: Again
questions.explanation: 'Uudestaan' means again.
questions.exampletranslate: I try again.

questions.question: To damage
questions.explanation: 'Vahingoittaa' (type 1 verb) means to damage; 'vahingoitan' is 'I damage'.
questions.exampletranslate: Littering damages nature.

questions.question: White wine
questions.explanation: 'Valkoviini' means white wine.
questions.exampletranslate: I drink a glass of white wine.

questions.question: Equipped
questions.explanation: 'Varustettu' means equipped; its genitive is 'varustetun'.
questions.exampletranslate: The cottage is well equipped.

questions.question: Boat
questions.explanation: 'Vene' means boat; its genitive is 'veneen'.
questions.exampletranslate: I row the boat on the lake.

questions.question: To go boating
questions.explanation: 'Veneillä' (type 3 verb) means to go boating; 'veneilen' is 'I go boating'.
questions.exampletranslate: I go boating on the lake in summer.

questions.question: Water system / Body of water
questions.explanation: 'Vesistö' means a water system or body of water (lakes and rivers).
questions.exampletranslate: A polluted water system is a problem.

questions.question: Environment
questions.explanation: 'Ympäristö' means environment.
questions.exampletranslate: I protect the environment.

questions.question: Ministry of the Environment
questions.explanation: 'Ympäristöministeriö' means the Ministry of the Environment.
questions.exampletranslate: The Ministry of the Environment makes a new law.
